== Summary ==
Errata posted by Aglets: Lord Maul, [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata)|Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]] and, after four omitted cards, [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)|Master Qui-Gon (V)]].

'''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p608385 (posted 21 March 2011). Screenshot taken in a web browser on 11 November 2026 (read-only), cropped to the post; the right-hand profile column is cut off. Where a post covers several cards, the other cards are cut out and marked "[... omitted ...]".
